site.name: Channel Concept Test — 2 Boreholes
site.description: Minimal two-borehole site designed to demonstrate how the Neural Implicit method uses semantic concept embeddings to shape geology. BH-01 (south) encounters thick sand/gravel, BH-02 (north) encounters thin sand/gravel. With the pre-loaded 'Palaeochannel E-W' concept, the neural field warps coordinates so the sand body is elongated E-W — perpendicular to the N-S borehole pair. Without the concept, interpolation produces a simple N-S gradient. Select 'Neural Implicit' method and click 'Build 3D Model' to observe the effect.
site.constraints:
Sand/gravel palaeochannel axis runs E-W through BH-01
Clay is the background matrix material above bedrock

geological_units.name: Topsoil
geological_units.description: Brown silty topsoil with rootlets. Variable organic content.

geological_units.name: Sand and Gravel
geological_units.description: Dense sub-rounded flint gravel in sandy matrix. Holocene alluvial channel fill. Drainage is good. SPT N 25-50.

geological_units.name: Stiff Clay
geological_units.description: Stiff to very stiff grey-brown fissured clay. High plasticity. Cu 80-160 kPa. Founding stratum for most structures.

layers.description: Dense sub-rounded flint GRAVEL in coarse sandy matrix. Saturated below 2.3m. SPT N = 38.
Stiff to very stiff grey-brown fissured CLAY. High plasticity (LL=68, PL=28). Cu 110-160 kPa.
Medium dense SAND and GRAVEL. Sparse gravel, dominantly coarse sand matrix. Channel margin facies.
Stiff to very stiff grey-brown fissured CLAY. Cu 90-140 kPa.

concepts.description: Palaeochannel trending E-W — concave-up erosional trough filled with sand and gravel, greatest thickness at BH-01 representing the channel axis, thinning northward to BH-02 at the channel margin
